observations: Player spent most of the round in two left-side pockets: cell 9 at col 1,row 1 (~x=150,y=150) for 7.2% and cells 49–50 at col 1–2,row 6 (~x=150–250,y=650) for 6.7% and 5.6%.

analysis.counterPlan: Put pressure on the left half of the arena, especially the x≈100–300 band where they repeatedly anchored at y≈150 and y≈650. Deny the spawn/burst window they farmed most heavily by staggering spawn timing so their 97-shot burst window and 113-shot spawn window do not line up cleanly again.
